opportunities.title: Independent Filmmaking in the Rockies: Production in Colorado
opportunities.summary: Filmmaker Max Walker-Silverman and producer Jesse Hope discuss making films in Colorado, with Colorado Film Commissioner Lauren Grimshaw Sloan on production incentives, grants and other resources from the Colorado Office of Film, Television and Media.

opportunities.title: From Sundance Film Festival Short to Feature with Liz Sargent (TAKE ME HOME)
opportunities.summary: A one-hour conversation with filmmaker Liz Sargent about expanding a short film into a feature, casting and directing family members, and grassroots distribution. Ends with audience Q&A. A recording is available within two business days.

opportunities.title: Film Club: THE BLAIR WITCH PROJECT
opportunities.summary: Host Kiva Reardon looks at the formal inventiveness and legacy of The Blair Witch Project, with clips, slides, Q&A and small-group breakout discussions.

opportunities.title: The Architecture of Fear: Directing Horror with Corin Hardy
opportunities.summary: A master class on horror filmmaking technique: storyboarding, creature design, working with cinematographers, VFX integration and sound design, plus building suspense and safe on-set environments.

opportunities.title: TV Writing: From Outline to First Draft of Your Pilot
opportunities.summary: Self-paced, 10 weeks: move from outline to a completed pilot draft under 60 pages, with written feedback at three points and six live class meetings. The source also lists a December 2026 session. Payment plan and limited need-based scholarships are offered.

opportunities.title: Directing: Core Elements
opportunities.summary: Self-paced, 8 weeks, for aspiring fiction film directors: script analysis, scene breakdown, directing actors, blocking, shot design and crew collaboration through to festival strategy. Beginner to intermediate, no prior experience required. 10% early-registration discount if registered by October 12.

opportunities.title: Directing Actors
opportunities.summary: Self-paced, 8 weeks, taught by Tessa Blake: working with actors from auditions through final cut, covering script analysis, casting and rehearsal approaches, blocking and on-set practice. Includes two written feedback submissions and four live class exercises, including simulated auditions.

opportunities.title: Screenwriting: Core Elements
opportunities.summary: Self-paced: create a treatment for your feature screenplay idea with an experienced screenwriter as your guide. Covers theme, character, three-act structure, conflict, world-building and revision. Suits first-time screenwriters. Two written feedback submissions.

opportunities.title: Drafting Your Feature Screenplay in Five Days
opportunities.summary: A live five-day workshop with instructor Kat O'Brien to move a screenplay from a seed of an idea to pages in under a week: pitching, outlining, writing sprints and small-group feedback. Recordings available for one year. Limited need-based scholarships are offered.

opportunities.title: The Essentials for a Successful Entertainment Career
opportunities.summary: Six-week live course with career coach Jim Arnoff on pitching, high-stakes conversations, giving and receiving feedback, and negotiating, with in-class feedback.

opportunities.title: Members-Only Online Screening: Take Me Home
opportunities.summary: Online screening of Take Me Home (91 min), winner of the Waldo Salt Screenwriting Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival, with a pre-recorded conversation with writer/director Liz Sargent.
opportunities.eligibility: Film Independent membership required (Film Lover, Secret or Arts Circle).

opportunities.title: 2027–28 FAFSA Opens October 1
opportunities.org: Louisiana Office of Student Financial Assistance
opportunities.summary: LOSFA states the 2027–28 FAFSA form becomes available on October 1, 2026, and that you must submit a FAFSA for each school year to maximize the aid you could receive. LOSFA uses the FAFSA for some state aid programs.
opportunities.deadlineNote: No deadline is stated on this page.

opportunities.title: Southeastern General Application (Foundation Scholarships)
opportunities.summary: Private donor, industry, alumni and Foundation scholarships are applied for through one general application at selu.academicworks.com. The source says the 2026–2027 application opened November 15, 2025 for current students and newly admitted students entering summer/fall 2026.
opportunities.deadlineNote: No deadline is stated on this page.
opportunities.note: Source lists the 2026–27 cycle; confirm the next cycle's dates with Financial Aid at (985) 549-2000.
